messages.subject: Executive Leadership Profile | ESG, Regulatory & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Scion Executive Search Team,

Your executive-search coverage across mission-driven, sustainability, regulatory and leadership functions aligns well with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across resources, energy and complex regulated sectors where institutional trust and responsible growth are strategic priorities. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
